parameters.content:
## Scraper Finder workflow

**Actor:** [Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/google-shopping-price-comparison-and-deal-finder)

**Workflow file:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/workflows/google-shopping-price-comparison-and-deal-finder.json

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Scraper Finder actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This uses the public actor endpoint. No org token is embedded.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` is best for small and medium runs. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.
- The input is a starter. Check the actor page for the current schema: https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/google-shopping-price-comparison-and-deal-finder

### Suggested input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `queries` (array)
- `productIds` (array)
- `category` (string)
- `countryCode` (string)
- `languageCode` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `condition` (string)
- `minPrice` (integer)
- `maxPrice` (integer)
- `onSale` (boolean)
- `freeShipping` (boolean)

description: Pull products from Google Shopping with the Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder actor, normalize the rows, and dedupe before writing to a sheet.
